semantics.behavior: Combinational lookup with no state or added latency
semantics.initialization: Original 0ns, 5ns, 10ns show a=x and q=x. Unknown input produces all-X output.
semantics.sampling: Replay original changes at 15ns then each 5ns through 90ns; observe after delta settling at each timestamp.

numeric.arithmetic: None; no rounding, overflow, or saturation

verification.oracle: Original problem waveform values, directly specified in testbench
verification.coverage: Initial X observations, every original timestamp, all 64 known-input transitions
verification.checks: Case inequality, fatal mismatches, bounded timeout, PASS marker; dev_check.py initial

specification_ambiguities.resolution: q is hexadecimal because values contain a-f; a is index 0-7.

specification_ambiguities.topic: Partially unknown or high impedance a
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Not specified by waveform; default all-X chosen, with official correctness limited to specified behavior.
